title: DuoLM: Fast and Effective Personalized Recommendation with Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.24481v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Language models can make personalized recommendations from rich item content, user history, and feedback. However, evaluating many candidates with full-text inputs incurs substantial online computation and limits serving throughput. We introduce DuoLM, a framework for fast and effective personalized recommendation that integrates a compact recommendation model with an efficient serving runtime. An encoder LLM learns compact item representations for offline reuse, while a personalized ranker LLM combines them with user history and feedback for recommendation. We train both models end to end with recommendation supervision and teacher distillation. The runtime further accelerates inference through virtual token IDs for embedding access, shared history computation, and CUDA Graph replay. Benchmark results show that our framework achieves recommendation quality comparable to that of the expert teacher model. On a single H100, it delivers

translated_title: DuoLM：基于语言模型的快速高效个性化推荐
translated_abstract: 语言模型能够基于丰富的物品内容、用户历史和反馈进行个性化推荐。然而，使用全文输入评估大量候选物品会带来巨大的在线计算开销，并限制服务吞吐量。我们提出了DuoLM，一个快速且有效的个性化推荐框架，它将紧凑的推荐模型与高效的推理运行时相结合。其中，编码器LLM学习紧凑的物品表示以供离线复用，而个性化排序器LLM则将这些表示与用户历史和反馈相结合来完成推荐。我们通过推荐监督和教师蒸馏对两个模型进行端到端训练。运行时系统还通过用于嵌入访问的虚拟token ID、共享历史计算和CUDA Graph重放进一步加速推理。基准测试结果表明，我们的框架实现了与专家教师模型相当的推荐质量。在单个H100上，它可以提供（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: DuoLM框架通过编码器LLM离线学习紧凑物品表示、个性化排序器LLM融合用户历史与反馈，并借助虚拟token ID、共享历史计算和CUDA Graph重放等运行时加速技术，实现了与专家教师模型相当的推荐质量，同时大幅提升服务吞吐量。
